name: Quick add
description: Choices you run from the palette or a new tab's buttons: a capture adds text to a note (at its top or end, or under a heading) and a template makes a new note from one of your templates, with {{DATE}}, {{VALUE}} asked for and {{LINKCURRENT}} filled in; a group offers several. Obsidian's QuickAdd choices are read too.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: The user's Quick add choices (a capture into a note, a note from a template): `quickadd_run` (`vau quickadd <choice> <value>`); `vau quickadd list` names them.
